user.title: Set up card recordings
user.description: Registers the bundled dashboard cards automatically. Records future forecasts before measurement. Optional Solar Independence uses measured AC flows with a solar-first allocation model; it is calculated, not directly metered source attribution. Confirm the Energy dashboard suggestions cover the same AC system and contain no overlapping totals. Counters start now; no history is fabricated.

data.enable_independence: Enable calculated Solar Independence (solar and battery serve home before grid)
data.charge_power: Battery AC charging power meters (positive charging)
data.discharge_power: Battery AC discharging power meters (positive discharging)
data.grid_inverted: Grid meters report export as positive

error.invalid_timeline: Select an Omnibattery schema 1 timeline with 96 quarter-hour intervals.
error.duplicate_power: Do not select the same power sensor twice or for multiple roles.
error.missing_power: Calculated independence needs grid, solar, battery charge and battery discharge power sources.
error.invalid_power: Every selected power sensor must currently report W or kW. Solar and battery channels must be non-negative.

yaml_resource.title: Update the Omnibattery Cards YAML resource
yaml_resource.description: Dashboard resources are managed in YAML. Replace all old Omnibattery Cards resource entries with exactly one entry using URL `{url}` and type `module`, then reload Lovelace resources and refresh your browser. Leave other cards unchanged. Automatic registration is paused to avoid loading duplicate scripts. See the repository migration instructions.
